summary.description: Thick, colourless to pale yellow liquids that are inert and insoluble in water. 4-nonylphenol is a common example.
emission_sources: Breakdown of nonylphenol ethoxylates in the environment
environmental_impact: Highly toxic to wildlife and persistent in the environment
Bioaccumulation and concentration in aquatic organisms and birds
Endocrine disruptors causing potential health problems in humans, though normal background levels are not thought to cause harm

top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Nonylphenols are highly toxic and bioaccumulate in aquatic organisms, severely impacting marine ecosystems and biodiversity.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Persistence and toxicity of nonylphenols in water affect water quality and safety for ecosystems and human use.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Releases occur mainly from industrial manufacturing and breakdown of chemical products, emphasizing the need for sustainable production and waste management.
